google-dataproc:equality-deletes:v2.notes: Not supported as a write operation. This is Spark's SQL DML (DELETE/UPDATE/MERGE), which never produces equality delete files -- only positional deletes on v2 or deletion vectors on v3. Equality deletes are produced by the Iceberg API and streaming writers (e.g. Flink upserts), not by Spark SQL, regardless of the Iceberg runtime version installed.

google-dataproc:equality-deletes:v3.notes: Not supported as a write operation. google-dataproc:multi-arg-transforms:v3.notes: V3 transforms over multiple source columns cannot be expressed by Iceberg's Spark integration, which rejects them with "Cannot convert transform with more than one column reference". Dataproc runs that same integration.
caveats: Inferred from the measured EMR Serverless and OSS Spark results, not measured on Dataproc itself; it is a limitation of the Iceberg Spark integration rather than of the platform.
Single-source transforms (bucket, truncate, year, month, day, hour) work, but they are not this feature: they work on format-version 2 as well.
